QuestInfo.name: [11th Anniversary] The Lost Bellflower Pot
QuestInfo.0: You lost your Bellflower Pot! If you tell Momma Bellflower the truth, she'll probably give you another chance.
QuestInfo.1: Ask Momma Bellflower for a new pot.
QuestInfo.2: You got a new pot from Momma Bellflower. Remember, you can't grow baby bellflowers or receive their gifts without a pot. Be careful not to lose this one!
